feedback.desc: ‏Report a problem or share an idea‏

gettingStarted.title: ‏Getting Started‏
gettingStarted.intro: ‏Keep Thy Heart is a Bible study tool. Use the search bar to navigate to any passage or search for words and phrases.‏
gettingStarted.referenceHint: ‏Type a reference like John 3:16 or Gen 1 to jump to a passage.‏
gettingStarted.searchHint: ‏Type any word or phrase to search across active translations.‏
gettingStarted.searchTypeHint: ‏Use the dropdown on the search bar to switch between Standard Search (keyword matching) and Ideas Search (matches the concepts in your query to the concepts in Bible verses).‏
gettingStarted.searchTypeHintMobile: ‏Switch between Standard and Ideas Search via the search bar dropdown.‏

biblePaneDesktop.title: ‏Bible Pane‏
biblePaneDesktop.translationSelector: ‏Use the translation selector to switch Bible versions.‏
biblePaneDesktop.displayModes: ‏Switch display modes: Reading (no verse numbers), Standard, or Study (with Strong's numbers and interlinear data).‏
biblePaneDesktop.strongsClick: ‏Click a Strong's number in Study mode to view its dictionary entry.‏
biblePaneDesktop.copyDialog: ‏Right-click any verse to access the Copy Passage dialog.‏

readingMobile.title: ‏Reading‏
readingMobile.translationSelector: ‏Use the translation selector to switch Bible versions.‏
readingMobile.displayModes: ‏Switch display modes: Reading, Standard, or Study (with Strong's numbers and interlinear data).‏
readingMobile.longPress: ‏Tap and hold a verse to access options like Copy.‏

navigation.title: ‏Navigation‏
navigation.bottomTabs: ‏Use the bottom tabs to switch between Read, Search, Study, and Commentary.‏
navigation.studyTab: ‏The Study tab shows cross-references, topics, and interlinear data.‏
navigation.commentaryTab: ‏The Commentary tab shows commentaries for the current verse.‏

commentaryAndSearch.title: ‏Commentary & Search‏
commentaryAndSearch.rightPane: ‏The right pane shows commentary for the current passage, updating as you navigate.‏
commentaryAndSearch.switchPanes: ‏Switch between Commentary and Search results using the tabs at the top of the right pane.‏
commentaryAndSearch.ctrlClick: ‏Ctrl+Click a search result to open it in a new tab.‏

settings.title: ‏Settings‏
settings.desktopOnly: ‏Notes, highlights, bookmarks, Scripture memory, reading plans and prayer lists are available in the desktop app.‏
settings.descMobile: ‏Tap the gear icon to customize theme, font, language and notification settings.‏
settings.descDesktop: ‏Click the gear icon to customize theme, font family, font size, line height, language and notification settings.‏

joining.title: ‏Joining‏
joining.share: ‏After going live, share the join code, link or QR so a television or phone can watch along.‏
joining.handoff: ‏Move control to another device hands the presenter role to a phone. It is a one-way door until the session ends, so keep it to people you trust.‏
joining.lock: ‏Lock joins stops new screens joining without disturbing the ones already watching.‏

notes.title: ‏Notes‏
notes.references: ‏Type verse references anywhere in your notes (John 3:16, Phil 4:6, Isaiah 26:3,4), optionally with a translation in brackets: each one becomes a plan item.‏
notes.hymns: ‏Type a hymn as hymn 460 or hymn Amazing Grace, optionally with verses (hymn 460 1,3,R). Lines starting Opening hymn or Closing hymn, or a line that is just a hymn title, also link.‏
notes.quotes: ‏Put a quote in a block quote, or start a line with Quote:. It shows as its own item. After a paste, a bar above the notes lists lines that may be a hymn or quote; accept or skip each. Selecting text offers to make it a verse, hymn or quote.‏
notes.highlight: ‏Make text bold under a verse to mark words to highlight. A matching bold phrase gets a subtle yellow underline; it does not appear on the screen until you reveal it.‏
notes.play: ‏Press the ▶ Show button before an item, or Ctrl/Cmd+click its text, to put it on the screen (a plain click edits). The green marker in the left gutter shows the last item shown.‏
notes.ctrlEnter: ‏Ctrl+Enter with the cursor in a reference, hymn or quote shows it.‏
notes.amber: ‏An amber item needs a choice (an unknown hymn, an ambiguous reference). Hover it to see why; click it to choose.‏

control.title: ‏Control‏
control.transport: ‏The three buttons are Back, Hide screen / Show screen (hides the screen without losing your place) and Next. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down and a clicker do the same; . or B blanks.‏
control.pickers: ‏Verse, Hymn and Quote open a picker: Show puts it on the screen, Add to notes writes it into your notes. Things shown this way and not yet in the notes appear under Shown, not in notes. On a phone, anything shown is added to the plan list.‏
control.chips: ‏When the verse on screen has highlights from your notes, they appear as chips. Click a chip, or press H, to reveal the next one; X clears them.‏
control.keys: ‏N / Shift+N shows the next / previous plan item. ? opens this help; / or Ctrl+K jumps to the command box. None of these act while you are typing in your notes or a field.‏
control.prepare: ‏You can prepare before going live: the preview runs on an offline copy. Go live starts the real session from exactly where you are, with the screen hidden until you press Show screen.‏

preview.title: ‏Preview‏
preview.what: ‏The preview is the real screen, scaled down. What you see is what the room sees.‏
preview.dblclick: ‏Double-click a word (or drag across words) to highlight it; click a highlight to remove it.‏
preview.clickVerse: ‏Click a neighbouring verse to move the screen there.‏
preview.presenterOnly: ‏These gestures work in the Presenter's preview only, never on the screens in the room.‏

command.title: ‏Command box‏
command.verse: ‏18, v18 or 18-20 goes to a verse in the current chapter; 3:16 goes to a chapter and verse in the current book; next and back step.‏
command.passage: ‏john 3:16, ps 23 esv, rom 8: a book, chapter and verse, with an optional translation (the default is used, with a note, if it is not installed). gen 1-2 and lists such as ps 23:1-3, 6 show the first part.‏
command.hymn: ‏hymn 460, hymn amazing grace, hymn 460 1-3. Alt+Enter on a typed verse or hymn adds it to the notes.‏
command.blank: ‏blank or . hides or shows the screen; clear clears highlights; ? opens help.‏
command.search: ‏Anything else is a search. Results appear in the Control pane; each has Show and Add to notes. Put a word in quotes, or start with ?, to force a search.‏
command.open: ‏Press / or Ctrl+K to focus it. Up and Down recall earlier commands.‏

simple.title: ‏Simple viewer‏
simple.what: ‏A screen you drive yourself, with no session, join code or notes: open it on a projector or a second window.‏
simple.open: ‏Open it from the Control "..." menu (Open simple viewer) or at /present/solo.‏
simple.prompt: ‏Press /, or click the small / at the bottom, to go to a verse. Arrow keys and . work as in the Presenter.‏
simple.noSearch: ‏Search is not available in the simple viewer.‏

study.title: ‏Presenting from Study‏
study.send: ‏In the Bible pane, the round button at the left of each verse sends it to the screen. A green check (and a green row) marks the verse on screen now. Alt+Enter sends the selected verse.‏
study.highlight: ‏To highlight a phrase, press and hold a word for about half a second, then tap the last word of the phrase. Send highlight puts it on the screen; Clear or Esc removes it.‏
study.companion: ‏The strip at the bottom shows what is on screen, with previous, next and blank buttons. Open Presenter takes you to the full Presenter (notes, plan and preview); the Presenter keeps running when you come back.‏
